transcript: Ishan, I'm 18. I don't know what to do with my life. So, I've been through that phase, and the most important thing that you need at 18 is confidence. First of all, learn how to speak well. Jab aap acha bolte ho, kisi ke samne achhe se khudko present kar pate ho, you will instantly feel a lot more confident about yourself. Number two, you are feeling bad about where you are in life because you don't have a skill that you mastered. Aap kisi bhi room me jate ho and if you have a skill that you own, you know that you are good at it and people will respect you for it. Lastly, know that all of us go through that same phase, and it's completely okay to feel lost when you are 18. You will have a 100 different options to do, and you don't have to decide right now. I am 25, and I have probably learned 10 different skills in the last 6 years, and I have not boxed myself into one thing, ki main ek developer hoon, ya designer hoon, ya sales wala banda hoon, ya phir content creator hoon, ya phir main ek public speaker hoon. I am all of it, and I am none of it. And that is the most important awareness you need when you are 18.
caption: Send this to a 18 y/o you know!
